rounds.name: Worker-Lowell
rounds.text:
Withholding pay gives the highest payoff in every outcome (5 tasks if they work properly, 1 task even if they cut corners), whereas trusting yields fewer tasks in both cases. Thus the safe optimal choice is to withhold.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Arden
rounds.text:
If I withhold pay, the worker still has an incentive to complete the job (getting 5 tasks) and even when they cut corners I still get 1 task, which is better than the zero I’d get if I trust and they cut. Thus withholding dominates in the worst case and gives a higher baseline.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Bexley
rounds.text:
Withholding gives the highest possible payoff regardless of whether the worker cuts corners (5 vs 3 tasks if they work properly, and 1 vs 0 if they cut). Since we want to maximize expected completed tasks, the safe choice is to WITHHOLD.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Ives
rounds.text:
Withholding pay gives the worker a stronger incentive to do the job properly (5 tasks vs 3) and still yields more tasks than trusting even when they cut corners (1 vs 0). Since it dominates in both possible worker behaviors, the safe choice is to withhold.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Jarvis
rounds.text:
Since withholding yields more completed tasks whether the worker does the job properly (5 vs 3) or cuts corners (1 vs 0), it dominates the trust option. Therefore the safest choice for maximizing tasks is to withhold pay.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Flint
rounds.text:
Withholding pay guarantees at least one completed task and can yield up to five, while trusting risks zero if the worker cuts corners. Since we want to maximize the guaranteed outcome and the worst‑case is better with withholding, the safe optimal choice is to withhold.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD

rounds.name: Worker-Ellis
rounds.text:
Trust gives the worker a safe payoff, so they may cut corners and yield zero tasks, while withholding pay creates a strong incentive to work properly for the higher reward of 5 tasks. Since we want to maximize expected completed tasks, the safer choice is to WITHHOLD.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD
